# SheetJS Community Edition

- Version: 0.20.3
- Official source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/
- License: Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE.sheetjs.txt`.

The official standalone build is saved as `xlsx.full.min.cjs` for the Node.js file conversion service. The original license header is retained. No runtime download or third-party CDN request is needed when users upload documents.
